segments.normalizedSource: ```objc //Mapping a BGRA buffer as a source texture: CVOpenGLESTextureCacheCreateTextureFromImage(kCFAllocatorDefault, textureCache, pixelBuffer, NULL, GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_RGBA, width, height, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 0, &outTexture); //Mapping a BGRA buffer as a renderbuffer: CVOpenGLESTextureCacheCreateTextureFromImage(kCFAllocatorDefault, textureCache, pixelBuffer, NULL, GL_RENDERBUFFER, GL_RGBA8_OES, width, height, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 0, &outTexture); //Mapping the luma plane of a 420v buffer as a source texture: CVOpenGLESTextureCacheCreateTextureFromImage(kCFAllocatorDefault, textureCache, pixelBuffer, NULL, GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_LUMINANCE, width, height, GL_LUMINANCE, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 0, &outTexture); //Mapping the chroma plane of a 420v buffer as a source texture: CVOpenGLESTextureCacheCreateTextureFromImage(kCFAllocatorDefault, textureCache, pixelBuffer, NULL, GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_LUMINANCE_ALPHA, width/2, height/2, GL_LUMINANCE_ALPHA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, 1, &outTexture); //Mapping a yuvs buffer as a source texture (note: yuvs/f and 2vuy are unpacked and resampled -- not colorspace converted) CVOpenGLESTextureCacheCreateTextureFromImage(kCFAllocatorDefault, textureCache, pixelBuffer, NULL, GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_RGB_422_APPLE, width, height, GL_RGB_422_APPLE, GL_UNSIGNED_SHORT_8_8_APPLE, 1, &outTexture); ```
